finding: the abstract contradicted the conclusions of the same document. It stated that the pilot and confirmatory study had not been executed, while the conclusions reported three executed blocks, and it still named the endpoint that had been falsified.
why_it_happened: the abstract was written before fifteen cycles of execution and was never revisited, so the summary drifted from the body it summarises
repair: the abstract now reports the three executed blocks, the falsified first endpoint with its measured false-positive rate, the cost instrument understatement, the mutation audit result, and the decision census
it continues to state that no efficacy estimate exists and that judged scoring is inadmissible

kinds: forbidden non-execution phrases while executed receipts exist
headline counts read from the receipts themselves rather than from the prose

duplicate_source_defect.issue: this round re-ingested arXiv:2608.25336 as a new source although it was already in the corpus under the bibliography key claimlocked2026, producing a second locator, a second matrix row and a duplicate bibliography entry
duplicate_source_defect.detected_by: the pre-commit validator, which refused the commit on locator, bibliography and matrix count mismatches
duplicate_source_defect.remedy: the duplicate locator, matrix row and bibliography entry were removed and the manuscript now cites the existing entry
